g.title: sequence
g.text: SIS registration commits first; simulator delivery is separate; automatic live delivery stays deferred

g.title: m1label
g.text: 1 Submit version, declarations and request key

g.title: m3label
g.text: 3 Resolve own attempt / plan; validate rules

g.title: m4label
g.text: 4 BEGIN · lock + replay lookup + live checks

g.title: m6label
g.text: 6 COMMIT; failure rolls back all success writes

g.title: async
g.text: SEPARATE WORKER · timer disabled on Vercel · registration is already authoritative

g.title: simband
g.text: SIMULATOR SELECTED · current runnable automatic path

g.title: m12label
g.text: 12 Delivery result or retry / manual review

g.title: liveband
g.text: ALTERNATIVE: LIVE-TEST REQUESTED · NOT_PROVISIONED before claims · no live enrolment

g.title: m13label
g.text: 13 Retain queued work; do not record false delivery

g.title: m14label
g.text: Own status read: receipt + truthful pending / simulator / live deferral

g.title: m15label
g.text: Return authoritative own registration / access status
